entities.name: Phosphate acyltransferase Q0A8R4
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q0A8R4; 342 aa; estimated molecular mass 36.28 kDa and theoretical pI 6.40.

Annotated as phosphate acyltransferase (EC 2.3.1.274), catalyzing reversible transfer of fatty acyl group from acyl-ACP to phosphate, yielding acyl-phosphate and holo-ACP; annotation specifies acyl-ACP, not acyl-CoA.
Reference annotation places enzyme in cytoplasm and lipid/phospholipid metabolism; homodimer and possible association with membrane via PlsY.
